name: Sun
description: The Sun is the star at the center of the Solar System.

name: Mercury
description: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun.

name: Venus
description: Venus is the hottest planet, with a thick toxic atmosphere.

name: Earth
description: Earth is the only known planet that harbors life.

name: Mars
description: Mars is the red planet, home of Olympus Mons.

name: Jupiter
description: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

name: Saturn
description: Saturn is famous for its spectacular ring system.

name: Uranus
description: Uranus rotates on its side and is an ice giant.

name: Neptune
description: Neptune is the farthest planet, with supersonic winds.
